def acquire():
    """Takes a connection from the pool, waiting at most the configured timeout."""
    try:
        return _connections.get(timeout=ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_MS / 1000)
    except queue.Empty:
        in_use = POOL_SIZE - _connections.qsize()
        log.error("pool exhausted", in_use=in_use, size=POOL_SIZE)
        metrics.increment("pool.timeouts")
        raise PoolTimeout(f"acquire connection timeout after {ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_MS}ms")
